executiveSummary.headline: Date and Govern the Open-Ended Renovation Notice
executiveSummary.lead: Falls Church Marriott Fairview Park leads its certified five-hotel set and appears in 43 of 46 eligible scenarios. The priority is to protect that position with current facts: date the open-ended renovation notice, reconcile event-space totals, and make the complimentary Mosaic/Metro shuttle, Tandem dining, outdoor venues, and 24-hour Peloton-equipped gym consistently usable.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: AI Consideration is the share of comparable monitored answers mentioning the hotel; Scenario Presence is the share of eligible traveler-need scenarios where it appeared. Certified Peer Position uses only the named certified Marriott Bonvoy set. These measures do not represent bookings, ADR, revenue, or traveler exposure.

themes.title: Date and Govern the Open-Ended Renovation Notice
themes.what: The overview says Ellipse and lower-half guest rooms will be renovated from November 23 through April, with lobby noise from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., but does not identify the year or a precise end date.
themes.whyItMatters: Guests and downstream systems cannot determine whether the disruption is current, planned, or completed.

themes.title: Reconcile Event-Space Totals and Capacity Language
themes.what: The overview markets 27,000 square feet; the events summary reports 28,411 square feet and capacity of 1,400, while meeting copy says events for up to 1,200 and wedding copy cites 840 banquet guests.
themes.whyItMatters: The capacity figures may reflect reception, theater, and banquet setups, but each needs explicit qualification and one signed inventory.

themes.title: Strengthen Metro-Shuttle, Dining, and Outdoor-Event Context
themes.what: Marriott verifies a complimentary neighborhood shuttle to Mosaic District and Metro, Tandem Restaurant & Bar, Starbucks, in-room dining, outdoor patios, and a 24-hour Peloton-equipped gym. ADP recognition was 14.1% for Metro access, restaurant at 88.6% and room service at 12.7%.1.3% for outdoor event space, and 3.8% for Peloton.
themes.whyItMatters: Consistent facts can help preserve category leadership without implying that any content change would change rankings or revenue.

executiveSummary.closing: Falls Church Marriott Fairview Park should treat its certified ADP result as a prioritization signal. The practical task is to protect or improve decision context with current, internally consistent official facts and documented verification—not to promise a visibility, booking, ADR, or revenue outcome.
